basics.description: **Botkins on Azure.** One VM runs Botkins and its own relay. When the deployment finishes, open **Outputs** and use the **pairingLink** on your phone to pair the Botkins app. Phones reach the server only through its own relay, over HTTPS on the VM's Azure DNS name.

location.label: Region
location.toolTip: Where the VM runs. If a size isn't available here, pick another region or size.

basics.name: vmName
basics.label: VM name
basics.toolTip: Also the start of the server's DNS name.

constraints.validationMessage: 2 to 40 letters, numbers and hyphens, starting with a letter.

basics.name: vmSize
basics.label: VM size
basics.toolTip: 2 vCPUs and 8 GB is the comfortable minimum.

options.text: Both are optional. Without them, sign in to a provider from the Botkins app after pairing: open the server's Screen and finish the sign-in page there. Tokens are passed in the VM extension's encrypted settings and kept only on the VM.

elements.name: claudeCodeToken
elements.toolTip: Run `claude setup-token` on a computer signed in to your Claude plan, and paste the token.

elements.name: githubCopilotToken
elements.toolTip: A GitHub token for an account with Copilot access (for example from `gh auth token`).

elements.name: pushNotifications
elements.label: Send iPhone notifications through relay.botkins.app
elements.toolTip: Notifications are sealed for your phone, and the Botkins relay only hands them to Apple. Turn this off to send none: then nothing leaves your server for Botkins' infrastructure.

elements.name: certificateEmail
elements.label: Certificate email (optional)
elements.toolTip: Receives only certificate notices, and lets the server fall back to ZeroSSL if Let's Encrypt is busy.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter an email address, or leave it empty.

toolTip.sshPublicKey: Choose Generate new key pair to have Azure make one and download the private key.

elements.name: sshAllowedFrom
elements.label: Allow SSH from (optional)
elements.toolTip: An IP address or CIDR range. Leave empty to keep SSH closed; you can still manage the VM with Azure Run Command.

constraints.validationMessage: An IPv4 address or CIDR range, or leave it empty.
